ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmful effects of? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmful effects of.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmful effects of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmful effects of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmful effects of.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Exploring weather? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Exploring weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Exploring weather.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Exploring weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Exploring weather.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and Sky its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and Sky its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and Sky its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and Sky its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and Sky its resources.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.

18. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

19. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

20. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
